gbm_population_evidence.quote: High Grade Glioma; Meningioma; Embryonal Tumor; Medulloblastoma; Anaplastic Ependymoma; Recurrent Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma; Recurrent Malignant Glioma

Patient must have a diagnosis of primary high-grade CNS tumor (any histopathologic diagnosis that is WHO grade III-IV) or meningioma (any histologic grade) that is recurrent, progressive, or refractory.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma never named in title, conditions, inclusion or arm label; WHO grade III-IV CNS tumours would include GBM but the manual requires explicit naming.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] LUTATHERA® (Lutetium Lu 177 dotatate) (other names: Lutathera): Lutathera: IV administration maximum dose of 200 mCi once every 8 weeks (one cycle) for total of 4 cycles (8 months)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Lutathera for Treatment of Recurrent or Progressive High-Grade CNS Tumors

role_evidence.quote: will receive Lutathera once every 8 weeks (1 cycle) for a total of 4 doses over 8 months

agents.drug_class_hint: 177Lu-labelled somatostatin receptor (SST2A)-targeted radioligand therapy (177Lu-DOTATATE); approved for GEP-NETs
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Lutathera (Lutetium \[Lu\]177 Dotatate) is a radionuclide therapy which binds type-2A somatostatin receptors (SST2A)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: SST2A (somatostatin receptor 2A) expression shown by DOTATATE PET uptake

source_quote.quote: Patients must have uptake on DOTATATE PET/CT in at least one tumor lesion (corresponding to known disease) equivalent to a Krenning score ≥2 (confirmed by central radiology review).

flag.reason: Entry requirement is imaging (DOTATATE PET) described as functional evidence of SST2A expression; unclear whether an imaging-defined target marker counts as a molecular biomarker.

source_quote.quote: Describe prevalence and heterogeneity of SST2A expression (IHC) in patients with recurrent or progressive High-Grade CNS tumors or meningiomas

coder_notes: Mixed-age (4-39 y) CNS tumour trial; glioblastoma not named anywhere, only HGG/malignant glioma and WHO grade III-IV CNS tumours, so coded high_grade_glioma_unspecified (exclude). Active moiety given as INN lutetium (177Lu) oxodotreotide; ligand is DOTATATE (oxodotreotide). [68Ga]Ga-DOTATATE PET is used for screening but is not a registered intervention, so not listed as an agent (R9). Stated mechanism quote contains backslash-escaped brackets as in the record.
